differences.what: Six storeys of round-arched windows over the iron shop fronts on both fronts, under a bracketed cornice and a slated mansard with dormers, the State Street front to the left and the Washington Street front to the right, where the engraving shows them
The tall mansard over the corner and the raised mansards at the State Street front's north end and the Washington Street front's east end
The State Street front's twelve window bays
The engraving groups the windows in pairs between heavy piers with small balconies; they are drawn as single arched windows at the same rhythm
The iron shop fronts are drawn as dark glazed bays; the engraving's pale iron columns and curtains differ in detail
The marble reads as the 1904 kit's marble, a shade warmer than the engraving's white paper
The roof crests' carving and the corner mansard's round window are drawn as plain arched dormers

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
